rules: Company-staff MSRs (Prototype Scope = Outside prototype) are not imported.
Bullets are joined into raw_narrative, which stays in the Delivery store.

Contract PMO staff map to SIM-TTO-<n>-PMO (direct contract assignment). Its REQ tasks (SIM-REQ-<n>-PMO-01..07) come from Volume 02 §3 program-management responsibilities; a PMO teammate other than the author reviews their MSRs in place of a TTO lead.
role_task_id is RT-<WR>; LR- leadership roles have no REQ eligibility.
Each employee is the reviewer of their own MSR; review is applied in the prototype, never at load.
TTO leads are the Technical Directors in Contract Task Orders; each may review only MSRs from employees in the TTO(s) they lead, including their own MSR.

Each contract's PMO team (Program Manager, Deputy Program Manager, Operations Manager, three Portfolio Leads) holds PMO review authority for that contract's PMO; the Program Manager is the primary reviewer. Like HR and other function staff, PMO staff are not aligned to a task order; their MSRs (v3) describe PMO work across the contract and map to SIM-TTO-<n>-PMO.
Each work role in a TTO has an individual REQ (SIM-REQ-<c>-<tt>-<WR>) generated from the Requirement Tasks tab.
